args.lesson: STOP. Algora's own llms.txt (TASK-179393256112) says it is now a full-time hiring platform with a 20% contingency fee; bounties appear only as 2023 history. The sitemap has job listings and 4 challenge pages but no bounties route. What worked: sitemap.xml and llms.txt are plain text, so they pass the host secret filter, while the HTML pages (root, challenges/tsperf) were rejected. Read a platform's llms.txt/sitemap first, before treating a 404 as a route change. Next time, check from the official self-description whether the platform still offers the business model before you open a mission on it. Do not reopen Algora unless an official text source shows an open rewarded challenge with readable rules AND a founder-authorized payout account exists.
